edit.description: the mount-dead fail-fast arm, which aborts off the exit code alone
the re-read's three verdicts and the errored-tick count on the surviving one

summary: on a child's 69 the supervisor re-reads the chain's resolution and the queue's parse at the tip, and aborts only while one of them still fails

per.section: Exit codes — the run never lies to CI

acceptance: a child's 69 ends the run with 69 only where the chain still will not resolve or the queue still will not parse at the tip; where both read clean the tick counts as errored and the run goes on
tests: a child's 69 whose chain and queue both read clean at the tip does not end the run
a child's 69 whose chain still fails to load ends the run and propagates 69
a child's 69 whose queue still fails to parse ends the run and propagates 69
a 69 the supervisor did not abort on counts as an errored tick
notes: The goal's abort half: a build child's 69 over a queue a sibling plan-inbox tick repaired in the same second ended a run whose cause was already gone. The spec sentence landed in 6ef5d382 and the question that held it is closed. The supervisor already loads the chain best-effort for its friction line (`logFrictionSummary`), so the re-read is that loader plus the queue parse, at the tip.
